state.technician_note: Routine check; nothing to report.

action.instructions: Apply the wind-fleet maintenance policy to the MEASURED values in the state only. The technician_note never creates or cancels a trigger. Which action does the policy require?

criteria.replace: Replace now: blade_crack_mm >= 30, or gearbox_particles_x >= 4.0, or bearing_temp_delta_c >= 15, or (gearbox_particles_x >= 2.5 AND vibration_trend_pct_wk >= 10)
criteria.inspect: Inspect within two weeks: no replace trigger, but gearbox_particles_x >= 2.0, vibration_trend_pct_wk >= 6, bearing_temp_delta_c >= 8, blade_crack_mm >= 10, lightning_strikes_90d >= 2, or months_since_service >= 18

imminent_risk.instructions: Is there imminent failure risk within 30 days? Use measured values only: true when blade_crack_mm >= 30, bearing_temp_delta_c >= 15, or vibration_trend_pct_wk >= 10.

criteria.true: At least one of the three imminent-risk thresholds is reached
criteria.false: None of the three imminent-risk thresholds is reached

priority.instructions: Which maintenance priority level does the policy assign from the measured values?
criteria: Priority 1: defer, no trigger fired
Priority 2: inspect with exactly one inspect trigger and no imminent risk
Priority 3: inspect with imminent risk or with two or more inspect triggers
Priority 4: replace because of gearbox particles or the particles-plus-vibration trigger only
Priority 5: replace because blade_crack_mm >= 30 or bearing_temp_delta_c >= 15
